title: Binanaz SMP Season 1 Panorama
description: The panorama and splash text for the members of the Binanaz SMP!
body: A panorama for the vanilla Minecraft menu! This recource pack includes a panorama shot from season 1 of the Binanaz SMP and 10+ splash texts. A new version will be uploaded every season, this recource pack does not need any mods to function.
